faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad (IIIT Allahabad), a premier government institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Medical Officer. Candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Medical Officer position under the IIIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Allahabad Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their applications for the Medical Officer posts is 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply for the Medical Officer positions through the offline mode by sending their completed application forms.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized medical college and have a minimum of 2 years of professional experience as a Medical Practitioner.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying to the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants interested in the Medical Officer post is 55 years as of the specified cut-off date.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the IIIT Allahabad Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Medical Officer recruitment at IIIT Allahabad.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer position includes a Personal Interaction, a Presentation, and a final Interview round.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for IIIT Allahabad?
faq.answer: The official website for the Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad, where candidates can find more details, is www.iiita.ac.in.
